clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Cathedral Square, Brother Kristoff preaches beneath Uther's statue. A human priest of the Church of the Holy Light, he stands outdoors near the great statue of Uther the Lightbringer and seeks practical books for sermons on spiritual strength.

Brother Kristoff serves the Church of the Holy Light in Cathedral Square, beneath the statue of Uther the Lightbringer. He works among the citizens and pilgrims who pass through the plaza, rather than remaining within the Cathedral of Light. For sermons such as the Fortitude of the Spirit, he turns to worldly comparisons. In The Stresses of Iron, he finds a way to explain how the mortal soul endures pressure, comparing the Holy Light's gift of inner resolve to the tempered strength of worked metal.
